title: New Work Order picks up a saved default without any new field
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, whose Bill Invoices To is saved as customer B, with one asset, asset 1.
  • Start on the Work Orders page.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Work Order.
  2. Pick customer A.
  3. Pick asset 1.
  4. Save the new work order.
  5. Expand the Customer card.
  6. Click Change Customer (the two arrows at the top right of the Customer card).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Work Order window opens with the same fields as before the release.

Step 2:

  • Customer A is picked.

Step 3:

  • Asset 1 is picked.

Step 4:

  • The new work order opens for customer A.

Step 5:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.
  • The Bill To is changed here, on the Customer card, never in New Work Order.

Step 6:

  • The customer picker opens: Change Customer is still on the Customer card.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page)

  • Out of Scope: “Bill To in New Work Order and New Part Sale. Neither window changes. A saved default applies on create and the Bill To is changed on the Customer card afterwards.”
  • Key Decisions: “A saved default Bill To, one hop, applied at creation only. Set in New Customer and Edit Customer; applied silently when a work order or part sale is created and shown on its Customer card.”
